$comment: The demo's own codelist decisions: which shipped lists it offers as UI pick lists (`useForUI`). The implementer-neutral facts about each list (gc, aliases, schematronValidated, inlineEnum, excludedCodes, externalSource) are in the PUBLISHED registry model/generated/registries/codelist-governance.json (vendored by `npm run model:sync`); model/codelists/governance.mjs merges the two. Every list in the published registry must have an explicit decision here (a test checks it).
